preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is between 1 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(2 <= n <= 3000 for n in [int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(t)])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of cities n is between 2 and 3000.

preconditions.expression: all(len(roads) == n-1 for n, roads in zip([int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(t)], [input().split() for _ in range(sum([int(input().split()[0])-1 for _ in range(t)]))]))
preconditions.description: Each test case has exactly n-1 roads.

preconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= int(x) <= n and 1 <= int(y) <= n for x, y in roads) for n, roads in zip([int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(t)], [input().split() for _ in range(sum([int(input().split()[0])-1 for _ in range(t)]))]))
preconditions.description: Each road connects two cities numbered between 1 and n.
The total number of roads across all test cases does not exceed 3000.

postconditions.expression: all(len(output) == 2*n-1 for n, output in zip([int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(t)], [input().split() for _ in range(2*sum([int(input().split()[0])-1 for _ in range(t)]))]))
postconditions.description: Each test case's output consists of two lines: the first line contains one integer r, and the second line contains n-1 integers c_i.

postconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= int(c) <= 10**6 for c in output[1:]) for output in [input().split() for _ in range(2*sum([int(input().split()[0])-1 for _ in range(t)]))])
postconditions.description: Each company number c_i is between 1 and 10^6.

postconditions.expression: all(int(output[0]) == max(collections.Counter(output[1:]).values()) for output in [input().split() for _ in range(2*sum([int(input().split()[0])-1 for _ in range(t)]))])
postconditions.description: The first line of each test case's output is the maximum number of roads assigned to any company.

postconditions.expression: all(all(len(set([c for x, y, c in zip(roads, roads[1:], output[1:]) if x == city or y == city])) <= 2 for city in range(1, n+1)) for n, roads, output in zip([int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(t)], [input().split() for _ in range(sum([int(input().split()[0])-1 for _ in range(t)]))], [input().split() for _ in range(2*sum([int(input().split()[0])-1 for _ in range(t)]))]))
postconditions.description: For each city, the number of different companies repairing roads connected to it does not exceed 2.
